search_boundary.purpose: Bounded comparator review for paper contribution scoping, not an exhaustive prior-art or patentability search.
methods: Deep review of the current MindMelody version and its architectural claims
Backward and neighboring-system search across affective brain-computer music interfaces, personalized affective players, music digital therapeutics, and generative affective systems
Primary DOI, publisher, PubMed, or arXiv identity verification
Explicit retention of null, mixed, and ambiguous evidence
search_boundary.absence_rule: not-reported means not found in the exact reviewed artifact; it never means the capability does not exist elsewhere or in unreleased work

dimension_definitions.state_inputs: Signals or reports used to represent the present moment
dimension_definitions.semantic_representation: Human-readable representation between state or intent and music controls
dimension_definitions.user_agency: Direct user specification, correction, preview, override, or stop authority
dimension_definitions.journey_representation: A target, transition, or time-varying affective path
dimension_definitions.audio_strategy: Selection, sequencing, synthesis, or learned generation strategy
dimension_definitions.within_session_adaptation: Feedback-driven change during one listening session
dimension_definitions.physiological_sensing: Use of EEG or peripheral physiology
dimension_definitions.evaluation: Participants, study structure, outcomes, and evidence status
dimension_definitions.provenance: Versioned lineage connecting intent, parameters, audio, and response
dimension_definitions.privacy: Reported consent, minimization, local processing, or access boundaries
dimension_definitions.clinical_positioning: How therapeutic or clinical relevance is framed

status_definitions.reported: Explicitly described or evaluated in the reviewed artifact
status_definitions.partial: Some elements are present but not the complete dimension
status_definitions.proposed: Future or conceptual capability, not evaluated as implemented
status_definitions.not-reported: Not found in the exact reviewed artifact
status_definitions.not-applicable: The dimension is outside the artifact's stated design

state_inputs.detail: EEG-derived global valence/arousal and local affect trajectory.

semantic_representation.detail: Qwen2.5-7B RAG planner produces a structured intervention plan from a music-intervention knowledge base.

user_agency.detail: Subjective feedback is collected; user-authored semantic controls, context confirmation, and stop/override contracts were not found.

journey_representation.detail: Global target plus local time-varying affect trajectory.

audio_strategy.detail: MusicGen-medium-based hierarchical controller generates fixed ten-second music examples.

generator_controls.detail: Plan fields include description, musical attributes, tempo, texture density, section dynamics, and target affect trajectory.

within_session_adaptation.detail: The paper describes EEG and subjective response closing the system loop.

physiological_sensing.detail: EEG is mandatory to the described architecture.

longitudinal_learning.detail: A durable within-person model updated across sessions was not found in v2.

evaluation.detail: DEAP cross-subject training, 2,000 labeled MusicCaps clips, and a randomized within-subject non-clinical pilot; pilot participant count was not found.

provenance.detail: An end-to-end reproducibility record connecting plan, model revision, artifact, and response was not found.

privacy.detail: A consent-scoped context projection, local-first data boundary, or detailed privacy model was not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Framed as personalized music intervention but explicitly evaluated as a non-clinical pilot; clinical protocols are future work.

comparators.version_reviewed: Journal of Neural Engineering version of record, 2016, doi:10.1088/1741-2560/13/4/046022

state_inputs.detail: EEG plus ECG, galvanic skin response, pulse, respiration, and felt-affect reports.

semantic_representation.detail: Valence/arousal states and case-based reasoning bridge target affect to musical generation; no user-extensible semantic language was found.

user_agency.detail: Participants identify felt affect and participate in calibration; explicit semantic knobs and context approval were not found.

journey_representation.detail: Current affect, desired state, and an affective trajectory are explicit.

audio_strategy.detail: Real-time algorithmic composition produces constrained monophonic piano music.

generator_controls.detail: Algorithmic musical parameters are conditioned by affective targets.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Online state detection and generated musical response close the loop.

physiological_sensing.detail: EEG and multiple peripheral signals are core inputs.

longitudinal_learning.detail: Person-specific models are trained over repeated sessions across several months.

evaluation.detail: Eight participants completed a longitudinal study; reported three-class accuracy reached 65% and modulation was above chance.

provenance.detail: Study procedures and datasets support reproducibility, but an Antidote-style per-session lineage object was not found.

privacy.detail: Research consent is implicit in the study design; data-minimization and local-first runtime controls were not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Music-therapy applications are discussed; the evaluated sample is healthy and non-clinical.

comparators.version_reviewed: PLOS ONE version of record, published 2019-03-18, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0213516

semantic_representation.detail: Interpretable valence/arousal-to-music mappings are reported; personal narrative semantics were not found.

user_agency.detail: Participants self-induce target emotions and calibrate the model; explicit user-facing mixins and consent projection were not found.

journey_representation.detail: Continuous trajectories through affective space can drive the generator.

audio_strategy.detail: Continuous synthesized music is generated in real time.

generator_controls.detail: Valence/arousal maps to controllable musical parameters with smooth evolution.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Online estimates update musical feedback every 0.5 seconds.

physiological_sensing.detail: Fourteen-channel EEG is mandatory in the evaluated loop.

longitudinal_learning.detail: User calibration and two BCI sessions are reported; durable multi-session learning was not established.

evaluation.detail: Music-algorithm listener study n=11 and preliminary BCI pilot n=5 with heterogeneous participant results.

provenance.detail: A public dataset is linked; per-generation intent-to-response provenance was not found.

privacy.detail: Local-first processing, contextual consent, and data minimization were not found in the reviewed article.

clinical_positioning.detail: Emotion mediation and self-regulation are discussed; the work is a proof of concept, not a clinical trial.

limitations: self-induced emotion is not therapeutic outcome

comparators.version_reviewed: Frontiers in Psychology version of record, 2023, doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1158172

state_inputs.detail: Continuous valence/arousal controls are inputs; live sensed state is proposed rather than evaluated.

semantic_representation.detail: Expert rules expose interpretable relationships between affect coordinates and musical features.

user_agency.detail: A person can supply valence/arousal controls; richer personal semantics and approval boundaries were not found.

journey_representation.detail: A trajectory may be predefined and updated over time.

audio_strategy.detail: Rule-based probabilistic classical generation runs in real time.

generator_controls.detail: Musical parameters are explicitly mapped and may update every bar.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Biofeedback integration is a target use, not part of the reported listener study.

physiological_sensing.detail: Future sensors may provide controls; no physiological loop was evaluated.

longitudinal_learning.detail: No durable person-specific update across sessions was found.

evaluation.detail: Twenty-six listeners rated 39 stimuli for perceived affect; felt emotion and health outcomes were not evaluated.

provenance.detail: Per-session intent, seed, audio, and response lineage was not found.

privacy.detail: The evaluated generator did not ingest personal context or physiological data.

clinical_positioning.detail: Designed for future music-based MedTech and self-regulation, without clinical outcome evidence.

comparators.version_reviewed: User Modeling and User-Adapted Interaction version of record, 2012, doi:10.1007/s11257-011-9107-7

state_inputs.detail: Skin temperature and reported affect are used with a personal music library.

semantic_representation.detail: Probabilistic per-song response models retain personal preferences, associations, and memories; no generative semantic plan is used.

user_agency.detail: The user supplies personal music and an affective goal.

journey_representation.detail: Current and goal affect guide selection; a continuous generated path is not represented.

audio_strategy.detail: Selects existing songs from the listener's library.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Physiological response informs selection, but seamless continuous regeneration is not used.

physiological_sensing.detail: Peripheral physiology is central to personalized response modeling.

longitudinal_learning.detail: Repeated real-world sessions build individual response models over weeks.

evaluation.detail: Three male participants, 27 songs each, nine sessions over roughly one month per person in a noisy workplace.

provenance.detail: A versioned end-to-end record from goal to response was not found.

privacy.detail: Modern local-first and consent-scoped context controls were not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Mood enhancement is the stated application; clinical efficacy was not tested.

state_inputs.detail: Two-second commercial EEG features plus song features and self-report.

semantic_representation.detail: Valence/arousal emotion variation is modeled; richer user-authored music semantics were not found.

user_agency.detail: Users designate the desired emotion variation and provide questionnaire feedback.

journey_representation.detail: Desired direction of emotional change is explicit; a time-indexed journey is not reported.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Continuous in-session adaptation was not found in v1.

physiological_sensing.detail: Commercial EEG is mandatory in the described system.

longitudinal_learning.detail: Person-dependent variation to the same song is modeled; durable repeated-session updating was not established.

evaluation.detail: The preprint reports prediction accuracy above 0.85 and questionnaire findings; independent replication was not found.

provenance.detail: A replayable decision and response lineage was not found.

privacy.detail: Consent-scoped context and local data architecture were not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Framed for daily emotion regulation, not a clinical trial.

overlap: person-variable response to the same song

comparators.version_reviewed: PLOS ONE version of record, published 2022-03-09, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0259312

state_inputs.detail: Self-reported current mood, target calm, trait anxiety, and musical preference.

semantic_representation.detail: Valence/arousal and preference guide the system; personal semantic mixins were not reported.

user_agency.detail: Users report current mood and preferences and retain ordinary study withdrawal authority.

journey_representation.detail: Iso-principle sequencing begins near current affect and moves toward calm over 24 minutes.

audio_strategy.detail: Reinforcement learning sequences precomposed instrumental tracks and nature sounds; an auditory-beat layer is factorially varied.

generator_controls.detail: The evaluated intervention selects and sequences existing audio.

within_session_adaptation.detail: The single-session sequence is personalized before playback rather than continuously redesigned from live response.

physiological_sensing.detail: No live physiological signal drives the evaluated sequence.

longitudinal_learning.detail: The randomized evaluation is a single session.

evaluation.detail: Open-label randomized study n=163 with four audio conditions and subgroup-dependent outcomes.

provenance.detail: Trial arms and algorithm are described; a session-level generative lineage object is not applicable.

privacy.detail: A local-first or context-minimizing runtime was not described.

clinical_positioning.detail: An anxiety study in people taking anxiolytics; design and conflict-of-interest limits remain material.

comparators.version_reviewed: IEEE EMBC version of record, 2011, doi:10.1109/IEMBS.2011.6090277

state_inputs.detail: Heart-rate variability is the biofeedback signal.

semantic_representation.detail: A human-readable affective or narrative representation was not found.

user_agency.detail: High-level user intent controls were not found.

journey_representation.detail: A physiological improvement target guides tempo variation; a semantic affective trajectory is not described.

audio_strategy.detail: Existing music playback is varied or selected through tempo control.

generator_controls.detail: Tempo is an explicit controllable acoustic feature.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Heart-rate variability closes the real-time music-tempo loop.

physiological_sensing.detail: Cardiac sensing is mandatory to the described loop.

longitudinal_learning.detail: Cross-session person-specific learning was not found.

evaluation.detail: Short conference report; evidence is insufficient for broad effectiveness or mechanism claims.

provenance.detail: A replayable session lineage was not found.

privacy.detail: Data governance details were not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Physiological improvement is in the title and design, but clinical effectiveness is not established.

limitations: selection or transformation rather than generative journey

state_inputs.detail: Two-channel frontal EEG and instructed happy/sad self-induction.

semantic_representation.detail: Estimated valence maps to explicit musical features; personal semantic language is absent.

user_agency.detail: Participants choose an instructed emotional target through self-induction; user-facing music controls were not reported.

journey_representation.detail: Target emotion and time are analyzed, but a rich generated journey plan is not used.

audio_strategy.detail: Stochastic music generation is rendered through Ableton Live.

generator_controls.detail: Mode, tempo, rhythmic density, and pitch register are controlled.

within_session_adaptation.detail: Real-time EEG estimates continuously drive musical controls through Lab Streaming Layer.

physiological_sensing.detail: Frontal EEG is mandatory to the prototype.

longitudinal_learning.detail: Durable individual updating across sessions was not found.

evaluation.detail: Preliminary n=22 evaluation found no significant target-emotion or time effect; manipulation explained 0.40% of variance.

provenance.detail: Technical components and synchronization are reported; end-to-end response lineage was not found.

privacy.detail: Local-first consent and data-minimization details were not found.

clinical_positioning.detail: Emotion self-regulation is the intended use, but the result is preliminary and negative for the control signal.

evidence_syntheses.version_reviewed: Frontiers in Neuroscience version of record, 2025, doi:10.3389/fnins.2025.1515377
evidence_syntheses.bounded_result: Music-neurofeedback systems form an established but heterogeneous research area without consensus measures of neurofeedback success.

evidence_syntheses.version_reviewed: Frontiers in Human Neuroscience version of record, 2026, doi:10.3389/fnhum.2026.1602004
evidence_syntheses.bounded_result: Commercial music-based digital therapeutics exist, but direct comparative and real-world effectiveness evidence remains limited.

candidate_combination: manual person-correctable moment state with optional fallible sensors
time-indexed journey plan with generate-ahead continuity
separate intended, realized-acoustic, perceived, and felt-response records
longitudinal within-person learning that begins as advisory rather than autonomous
antidote_reference_profile.evidence_boundary: The comparator search has not established that this exact combination is novel, effective, safe, implemented, or clinically useful.

novelty_decisions.claim: Antidote is the first closed-loop affective music system.
Antidote is the first system to map current state toward a desired affective target or trajectory.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: Current-to-target selection, sequencing, and generation are established precedents.

novelty_decisions.claim: Antidote is the first real-time generative affective music system with smooth transitions.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: Continuous and bar-level real-time affective generators already exist.

novelty_decisions.claim: Antidote is the first personalized or longitudinal affective music learner.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: Person-specific response models, personal associations, and repeated-session learning all have prior precedent.

novelty_decisions.claim: Antidote is the first to use an interpretable semantic or musical planning layer.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: Structured intervention plans and interpretable affect-to-music mappings already exist.

Moment specificity alone is prior art; the remaining candidate concerns explicit semantic/context controls, realization verification, response separation, consent, provenance, and longitudinal use in combination.
Feature mappings and structured plans are prior art; Antidote's remaining candidate is inspectability across context selection, intent, realized acoustics, response, and model update.

novelty_decisions.claim: The exact governed combination in the Antidote reference profile may constitute a useful research-system contribution.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: The bounded search did not find the exact combination, but absence from this search is not proof of novelty; issue #35 must freeze narrower contribution language.

novelty_decisions.claim: A user-extensible semantic-to-realized-acoustic-to-felt-response mapping can be learned within one person across moments.
novelty_decisions.bounded_result: The literature supplies neighboring components but does not validate Antidote's complete mapping hypothesis.
